[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | artisan = y | collector = y }} [[Nebo Terrace]] is a well populated province in north-central Kryta. There are settlements along all the edges and a central village, also named [[Nebo Village|Nebo]]. In the southwest, [[undead]] from the swamps are making incursions. ==Getting there== Head east out of [[Beetletun]] or north from [[Bergen Hot Springs]]. ==Shrines== ;Resurrection shrines:
